text:
The diagram shows a lamp and a resistor connected in a circuit. The lamp is too bright.
Which change to the circuit will decrease the current in the lamp and make it less bright?
A
connecting another resistor in parallel with the one in the circuit
B
connecting another resistor in series with the one in the circuit
C
exchanging the positions of the lamp and the resistor in the circuit
D
increasing the e.m.f. of the battery in the circuit

options.label: A
options.text: connecting another resistor in parallel with the one in the circuit

options.label: B
options.text: connecting another resistor in series with the one in the circuit

options.label: C
options.text: exchanging the positions of the lamp and the resistor in the circuit

options.label: D
options.text: increasing the e.m.f. of the battery in the circuit
